title: Brazilian Pasta with Aromatic Vegetables
description: A flavorful and vibrant vegetarian pasta dish, inspired by the cuisine of Brazil, featuring aromatic vegetables and snappy texture.

ingredients.name: aromatic
ingredients.notes: such as red bell pepper, zucchini, and mushrooms

instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add chopped onion and cook for 3-4 minutes until softened.
Add minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add sliced snow peas and cook for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Stir in cooked pasta and season with salt and pepper to taste.
